limitations: New corpus is internally family-disjoint and reviewed; underlying T3 meanings may exist in original legitimate TRAIN.
Extraction measured directly with injected intended intent to avoid unavailable preflight masking.
No observed400 or historical stress/reference content was read.
Slot metrics are authored gold recall; unexpected extra slots reported separately, not claimed harmless.
Small held-out per-language/class supports create large uncertainty; neither dataset is an untouched external acceptance test.
